## Verse 1

::: {.cline}
<span class="ln"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Am</span>Hanukkah, Oh Hanukkah</span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="cw">Come light the menorah</span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Am</span>Let’s have a party</span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="nb"><span class="cw">We’</span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">G</span>ll </span></span><span class="cw">all dance the </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">C</span>hora</span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Am</span>Gather round the </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">G</span>table,</span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="cw">We’ll </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">C</span>give you a </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">C/B</span>treat.</span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Am</span>Dreidels to play with </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">E7</span>and </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Am</span>latkes to eat</span></span>
:::

## Verse 2

::: {.cline}
<span class="ln"><span class="cw">And </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Am</span>while we are </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Am</span>playing,</span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="cw">The </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">C</span>candles are </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">G</span>burning </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">C</span>low. </span><span class="cw bare"><span class="ch">E7</span></span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Am</span>One for each </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Dm</span>night, they </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Am</span>shed a sweet </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Dm</span>light</span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="cw">To </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Am</span>remind us of </span><span class="nb"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">E7</span>days long a</span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Am</span>go.</span></span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Am</span>One for </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Dm</span>each night, they </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Am</span>shed a sweet </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Dm</span>light</span></span>
<span class="ln"><span class="nb"><span class="cw">To re</span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Am</span>mind </span></span><span class="cw">us of </span><span class="nb"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">E7</span>days long a</span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Am</span>go.</span></span></span>
:::
